Send one task to **A11, the Process Development Expert**, and nothing else. No planning

## What this specialist covers

Translate laboratory formulations into robust, scalable, commercially manufacturable softgel processes and define the CPP and control strategy

## How to launch

```bash
cd "{{NEUCLEUS_ROOT}}" && uv run python scripts/enqueue_run.py \
```
